problem:
The inverse of the matrix $V$ is found using row operations, as shown below. What are the row operations corresponding to each step?

$$
\begin{aligned}[V\,|\,I\,] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & \text{___________} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}] &  & \text{___________} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{1}{2} \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Finding the Inverse of a 2x2 Matrix Using Row Operations
